name: Wanaka Studio
tagline: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine
description: The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

name: Floot Payments
tagline: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude
description: Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for "a $9/month plan", "a checkout for this course" or "shipping labels for my orders", and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish.

name: Prelulu
tagline: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story
description: Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability.

name: Render Sandboxes
tagline: A computer for every agent
description: Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app.

name: OpenMail
tagline: Give your AI agents an identity through email
description: Your agents sign up for tools, receive verification codes and reply to customers, mostly from your Gmail or a shared sending pool where one bad actor gets everyone flagged. OpenMail gives every AI agent its own inbox on your domain with its own sending reputation, for one API call each. Incoming mail reaches your code over webhook or WebSocket, attachments arrive as text, and there's a hosted MCP server and a Hermes plugin. Built and hosted in the EU, free for 3 inboxes.

name: Orphex MCP
tagline: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP
description: Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 65+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context. Move your AI beyond QA: empower it to analyze integrated performance and take every action a human marketer can. Reallocate budgets, pause unprofitable creatives, or adjust products from a single prompt. Every change is logged and protected by safety guardrails. Start free, 30% off the first month.

name: OpusClip 4.0
tagline: Turn raw footage into ready-to-publish videos with AI
description: OpusClip 4.0 goes beyond AI clipping to edit raw footage into finished videos. Automatically clean up speech, add captions and B-roll, create multiple formats, apply saved editing styles, and generate animated hooks and motion graphics.

name: fileForensics
tagline: Real or not? Check files before your AI trusts them.
description: fileForensics is a trust check for every file your app or agent acts on. Extraction tells you what a document says; fileForensics tells you whether to believe it. It looks for signs of editing, AI-generated content, tampering and details that don’t add up, then returns findings with the evidence: what, where and why. No black-box score. All delivered in one call and works via API, MCP (Claude, Cursor, Codex), the developer portal and the fileAI platform. Check the file before you trust the data.

name: Mellow Kids
tagline: Personalized sleep and development app for parents
description: Most baby apps track what happened. Mellow Kids explains why, and what comes next. 🌙 Understand today: Log sleep, feeds and diapers easily. Mellow spots changes and tells you why. A routine to adjust, or a phase that will pass. 🔮 Prepare for tomorrow: A heads-up before sleep and development change, so you feel ready for each new stage. 🌱 The right guidance at the right time: Evidence based support, from short naps to separation anxiety and first tantrums.

name: KREV AI
tagline: An AI team that runs your ecommerce brand
description: KREV 2.0 is an AI team for your ecommerce brand. Scout tracks 10M+ competitor ads, Luna makes content that looks real, Kai buys your media, Chloe posts what's trending, Rue sends your emails, Toshi edits your store and Max gets you found.

name: Dessn
tagline: The design canvas that runs your real code.
description: When product teams ship fast with AI, it's hard to keep track of what's live and keep it consistent. Dessn runs your codebase on a design canvas, always in sync with prod, so your team and agents work from one shared source of truth. • Audit your product and find inconsistencies • Map user flows with states and personas • Comment, branch and iterate together • Share prototypes for reviews, user tests or sales demos. Connect GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket in one click. Works with every tech stack.

name: Zero Wire
tagline: Check your exposure to critical CVEs with one agent prompt
description: Zero Wire is a free vulnerability intelligence feed from Cloudflare Radar for security leads and engineers. Unlike CVE databases that list everything, it picks the critical issues in Internet-facing software and explains each in plain language: what's affected, who should check, and what to do now, with links to CVE records, vendor advisories and CISA KEV. Each briefing includes a ready prompt for your AI agent to run a read-only exposure check. No account needed.

name: Basedash Verified dashboards
tagline: Show your team which dashboards to trust
description: Basedash admins can now mark a dashboard as verified, the same way they verify models. Open the dashboard's more menu, pick Verify dashboard, and a green Verified chip appears next to its name for everyone who opens it. Hover it to see who verified it and when. Only admins can verify, edits keep the verification, a duplicate starts unverified, and every change lands in the audit log. Stop guessing which numbers are right. Show your team which dashboards to trust.

name: Deployed Yet?
tagline: See if your Vercel, Cloudflare and GitHub deploys shipped
description: A free, open-source Mac menu bar app that answers one question: did it ship? Add as many Vercel, Cloudflare (Workers and Pages) and GitHub Actions accounts as you have, pick the projects to watch, and the menu bar shows ? while building, ✓ when it's live and ! when it broke. Get notified when a deploy fails or production goes live. Tokens stay in your Keychain and are only sent to the provider APIs.

name: TellPip
tagline: A little bird that whispers what to say in your calls
description: TellPip listens to your calls from your Mac (no bot joins), transcribes on-device, remembers what you promised each client and whispers the answer from your own documents when you're asked. Invisible in screen sharing. Built in Europe, with GDPR in mind.

name: Hira
tagline: Your free personal agent for job search
description: Applying to jobs is tedious and time-consuming. Stop applying manually and let Hira, your personalized AI agent, do everything for you. You can text it, connect it to Muse, or go through our website. All for free.

name: CardPointers 8
tagline: Earn more rewards from your credit cards every day
description: CardPointers helps everyone with a credit card earn more points and cashback by always using the right card for every purchase. Available as a free download with a premium CardPointers+ tier help users save even more, CardPointers 8 is the biggest update yet, incorporating many new iOS 27 technologies.

name: QualityLayer
tagline: Plan, build and review software with your coding agents
description: QualityLayer takes each code change through seven steps: Discuss, Research, Plan, Outline, Implement, Verify and Review. You comment on diagrams and clickable screens and approve the Plan before code changes. Your agent builds it test first, and a fresh agent that did not write the code checks the result against your request. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and four more on your own subscription, and runs on your computer. https://github.com/maxritter/qualitylayer

name: LiveReacting for ChatGPT
tagline: Run 24/7 and pre-recorded live streams from ChatGPT
description: LiveReacting is now a plugin in ChatGPT. Type @LiveReacting and ask. ChatGPT builds a looping playlist from your library and starts a 24/7 live stream, or schedules a recorded video to go live later. Stream to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, LinkedIn, X or custom RTMP at once, change the playlist while live, and check status and viewers. We run the stream, so your computer can be off. Every paid plan includes the plugin.

name: Sendu
tagline: Drop files easily across your local network
description: Drop files easily over your local Wi-Fi: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux, and Android TV. No cloud, no cables, no account — devices talk directly, end-to-end encrypted. Send photos, 4K videos, or whole folders in three taps at full local speed. Stream native-quality video to a D-pad Android TV app, or share a folder once and pull files from any device. Files never leave your network. P2P file transfer is free. Sendu Pro unlocks TV streaming and live shared folders.
